note: Design rows and style refusals of the player cars beyond the first 14 (blender/body_fit.py load_extra()). deck = [rear edge y, front limit y] of the rear deck a pedestal wing may stand on; roofEdge = y of the roof's rear edge on hatches, vans and pickups (pedestal wings refused there); rackYs = roof run for the roof items when the measured one is wrong. Root frame, metres, read off the centre-line profiles of the 2.50 meshes. like = a trim of a car listed earlier: its design row and style refusals are taken over, the row's own keys win. exclude = {group or part id: reason}; allow = refusals of the like car lifted. Measured refusals (cuts, floats, ground, tyres, slopes) are computed by body_fit.py, not listed here.
